> what does "esc to interrupt" mean in the status line?

● It is the hint Claude Code shows while it works: press esc to interrupt
  the current turn.

● The spinner line reads like "✻ Thinking… (esc to interrupt)".

● That's all there is to it.

  Anything else?

● Waiting for your next message.
